q: “Zup, man?” the thin voice said. “Ethan, dude. Grab some people and meet me outside. I'm in the Jimmy.”

e: From zupan + -ate (forms nouns denoting rank or office, the concrete charge of it).
Borrowed from Italian zuppa. Doublet of soup.
Of Slavic origin, from Proto-Slavic *županъ, from *župa (“area, district”).
